1309-8043-8350.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast a spell for free using Vision this turn.
1309-8043-8350.description:
Cast Face Yourself for free due to Vision, targeting yourself and creating a token copy of each creature you control with haste and the noted exile clause.
Put the copy of Vision whose ability has been used in your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When the Salvager of Secrets token enters, it triggers, returning Face Yourself from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

1479-5700-5701-6528-8345.notablePrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
1479-5700-5701-6528-8345.description:
Play Petrified Field.
When Petrified Field enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree and Elfsworn Giant trigger.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, putting nothing onto the battlefield.
Holding priority, activate Petrified Field's second ability by tapping and sacrificing it, returning Echoing Deeps from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Elfsworn Giant trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree triggers, putting Echoing Deeps from your hand onto the battlefield untapped as a copy of Petrified Field.
When Echoing Deeps enters the battlefield, Elfsworn Giant triggers.
Holding priority, activate Echoing Deeps using Petrified Field's second ability by tapping and sacrificing it, returning Petrified Field from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Elfsworn Giant trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree triggers, putting Petrified Field from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Petrified Field enters the battlefield, Elfsworn Giant triggers.
Repeat from step 4.

240-1879-5470-7272.notablePrerequisites: You have at least four card types in your graveyard.
240-1879-5470-7272.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Reaper of Flight Moonsilver by sacrificing an Egg token.
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Reaper of Flight Moonsilver ability, giving Reaper of Flight Moonsilver +2/+1 until end of turn
Repeat from step 2.

424-868-8220.description:
Cast Three Tragedies by paying its mana cost, targeting yourself.
Holding priority, cast Desperate Ritual by paying its splice cost, adding its effects onto Three Tragedies.
Holding priority, activate Mirror Sheen by paying {1}{U/R}{U/R}, copying Three Tragedies, which also has the effects of Desperate Ritual, targeting an opponent.
Resolve Three Tragedies, adding {R}{R}{R}.
Repeat from step 3.

678-5670-7192--52.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is at least 2.
678-5670-7192--52.description:
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing the nontoken creature that can be cast using one colored mana.
When the creature dies, Grave Venerations and Enduring Renewal trigger.
Resolve the Grave Venerations trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life
Resolve the Enduring Renewal trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Warren Soultrader ability, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding one mana of any color.
Cast the creature by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

2558-3490-4050-8095.description:

Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Sword of the Meek triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to the Servo.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Servo, adding {1}.
Repeat.

2358-3629-8089.description:
Activate Blood Celebrant by paying {B} and 1 life, adding {B}
Repeat step 1 until you have 0 life.
Cast Mister Negative by paying {5}{W}{B} plus commander tax if applicable.
When Mister Negative enters, it triggers, swapping your life total with an opponent's.
The opponent loses the game due to having 0 life.

1170-3836-5131-6798--202.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast an artifact spell using Muldrotha this turn.
1170-3836-5131-6798--202.description:
Cast the artifact from your graveyard using Muldrotha's ability by paying {0} due to Urza.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Muldrotha, allowing you to use its ability again this turn.
Resolve the artifact spell.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing the artifact, causing you to surveil 1

requires.n: Instant or Sorcery that Targets a Creature and Creates Treasure
Creature that Returns an Instant or Sorcery from Graveyard to Hand on Entering

6106-7845--178--179.description:
Cast Electroduplicate by paying its mana cost targeting the creature that can recur spells.
When you cast that spell, Spinerock Tyrant triggers, copying Electroduplicate and choosing Spinerock Tyrant as its target.
Resolve the copy of Electroduplicate, creating a Spinerock Tyrant token.
Resolve the original Electroduplicate, creating a token copy of the spell recursion creature.
When that token enters, it triggers, returning Electroduplicate from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat from step 1 one additional time, resulting in a total of five Spinerock Tyrants.
Cast the spell that creates a Treasure token by paying its mana cost, targeting any creature.
Each copy of Spinerock Tyrant triggers, copying that spell once for each Spinerock Tyrant you control.
Resolve all copies of that spell, creating at least one Treasure token each time.
Activate those Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding one mana per Treasure.
Cast Electroduplicate by paying its mana cost targeting the spell recursion creature.
When you cast that spell, each copy of Spinerock Tyrant triggers, copying Electroduplicate once for each Spinerock Tyrant and choosing the spell recursion creature once and Spinerock Tyrant as each additional spell's target.
Resolve all copies of that spell, creating two copies of the spell recursion creature and additional copies of Spinerock Tyrant.
When the first spell recursion creature token enters, it triggers, returning the spell that creates Treasure from your graveyard to your hand.
 When the second spell recursion creature token enters, it triggers, returning Electroduplicate from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat from step 7.
6106-7845--178--179.notes: The mana needed is calculated assuming you use a spell that costs 2 to cast and creates one Treasure token.

147-3125-6797.notablePrerequisites: You have two creature cards in your graveyard.
147-3125-6797.description:
Cast Victimize by paying its mana cost
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, targeting Victimize.
Holding priority, activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, copying Victimize
Resolve the Victimize copy, sacrificing a creature and returning Dualcaster Mage and another creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

Repeat from step 2.

2034-2301-7084.easyPrerequisites:
You control a land.
You control another nonland creature.
2034-2301-7084.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing another nonland creature.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land you control.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the earthbent land.
When the land dies, Abzan Ascendancy and Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger.
Resolve the Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Abzan Ascendancy trigger, creating a creature token.
Repeat.

Holding priority, activate Kitsa's second ability by paying {2} and tapping it, copying Under the Skin.
Resolve the copy of Under the Skin, causing you to put a card from your library onto the battlefield face-down as a 2/2 creature.

Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the face-down creature, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat from step 3

Cast Kirol by paying {1}{R/W}{R/W}
When Kirol enters, Molten Echoes triggers.
Holding priority, activate Kirol by tapping it and another creature you control, copying Molten Echoes's trigger.
Resolve the copy of Molten Echoes's ability, creating two token copies of Kirol with haste.
Holding priority, activate a Kirol token by tapping both Kirol tokens, copying Molten Echoes's trigger.
Repeat from step 4.

1570-2660-7028.description:
Cast Sage of the Falls by paying {4}{U}.
When Sage of the Falls enters, it triggers, causing you to loot. The discarded card will be put on top of your library instead of into your graveyard due to Wheel of Sun and Moon.
Wan Shi Tong's second ability triggers, creating two 1/1 Spirit creature tokens.
When the Spirits enter, Sage of the Falls triggers twice.
Resolve the first trigger, choosing not to draw a card.
Resolve the second trigger, causing you to loot. The discarded card will be put on top of your library instead of into your graveyard due to Wheel of Sun and Moon.
Repeat from step 3.

2919-3330-3490-5231.description:
Gain life.

When the Servo enters, Leyline of Vitality triggers, causing you to gain life.
Archangel of Thune triggers. Holding priority, activate Thermopod by sacrificing the Servo, adding {R}.
Resolve the Archangel of Thune trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control 
Repeat from step 3.

Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Visionary Augmenter.
When Visionary Augmenter dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Visionary Augmenter enters, its fabricate ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.

When Diamond Lion dies, Koll triggers, returning Diamond Lion from your graveyard to your hand.

When the Elemental dies as an artifact due to Biotransference, Dross Scorpion triggers, untapping the creature with Elemental Mastery attached.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Repeat.

Holding priority, activate Echo Mage by tapping it, copying Electroduplicate twice, with both copies targeting Biovisionary.
Resolve all Electroduplicate spells, creating three token copies of Biovisionary.
At the beginning of your end step, each Biovisionary triggers. Resolve the first trigger, causing you to win the game.

2557-3951-5703-5744.easyPrerequisites: An opponent cannot block and kill Altaïr
2557-3951-5703-5744.description:
Declare Altaïr as an attacker, triggering its ability, exiling Éomer from your graveyard with a memory counter on it and creating two tapped and attacking copies of Éomer.
Put all but one Éomer token into your graveyard due to the legend rule, causing you to get at least one Éomer trigger, causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
At the end of your combat phase, Altaïr triggers, causing you to exile the Éomer token.
Repeat each combat phase.

1306-1690-2538-5645.description:
Activate Mana Crypt by tapping it, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Words of Wind by paying {1}.
Cast an artifact by paying {0}.
Jhoira triggers, causing each player to return a permanent they control from the battlefield to their hand due to Words of Wind, with you returning Mana Crypt to your hand.
Activate Words of Wind by paying {1}.
Cast Mana Crypt by paying {0}.
Jhoira triggers, causing each player to return a permanent they control from the battlefield to their hand due to Words of Wind, with you returning the artifact cast in step 3 to your hand.
Repeat.
1306-1690-2538-5645.notes: You can use a historic creature to get infinite ETB and LTB triggers. If you do not use a creature, this combo will not produce those results.

When the creature enters, it triggers, creating at least two creature tokens.
Activate the creature and two tokens by tapping them, adding at least {3}.

2104-2304-3019-4872-5546.notablePrerequisites:
You have not cast an instant or sorcery spell this turn.
Temporal Manipulation and Time Warp exiled by Arcane Bombardment.
2104-2304-3019-4872-5546.description:
Cast Inspiring Refrain by paying {4}{U}{U}.
Arcane Bombardment triggers, exiling a random instant or sorcery from your graveyard, and then casting a copy of Temporal Manipulation and Time Warp without paying their mana costs.
Resolve the Temporal Manipulation and Time Warp copies, causing you to take two extra turns after this one.
Resolve Inspiring Refrain, causing you to draw two cards and exile Inspiring Refrain with three time counters on it.
Activate Jhoira's Timebug by tapping it, removing a time counter from Inspiring Refrain.
Move to your first extra turn, removing a time counter from Inspiring Refrain during your upkeep.
Move to your second extra turn, removing a time counter from Inspiring Refrain during your upkeep.
Inspiring Refrain triggers, causing you to cast it from exile without paying its mana cost.
Repeat from step 2.

2105-2923-4050.description:

Declare Combat Celebrant as an attacker, choosing to exert it as it attacks.
Combat Celebrant triggers, untapping all other creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Combat Celebrant, adding one mana of any color.
Repeat each combat phase.

You control at least two Plains.
Archelos is untapped.
1315-1637-3505-4423-4826.description:
Activate Mystic Sanctuary and two Plains by tapping them, adding at least {1}{W}{W}.
Activate Zuran Orb three times by sacrificing Mystic Sanctuary and two Plains, causing you to gain 6 life.

When each land enters the battlefield, Aesi triggers that many times, and Mystic Sanctuary triggers once.
Resolve the Mystic Sanctuary trigger, putting Second Sunrise on top of your library from your graveyard.
Resolve the Aesi triggers, causing you to draw that many cards.
Repeat.
If you control additional lands, you may sacrifice them as well to get additional mana and triggers.

328-3260-4078-5147.easyPrerequisites:

You have at least two opponents, or your devotion to black is at least ten.
328-3260-4078-5147.description:

Activate Chainer by paying 9 life due to K'rrik, returning Gray Merchant from your graveyard to the battlefield as a Nightmare in addition to its other creature types.
When Gray Merchant enters, it triggers, causing each opponent to lose life equal to your devotion to black and causing you to gain that much life.
Repeat.
328-3260-4078-5147.notes: The additional gained life can be used by Chainer to return all creature cards from all graveyards to the battlefield under your control.
